title: Pure Kaiju
summary: Pure Kaiju cards with generic staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Every Kaiju Special Summons itself onto the opponent's field by Tributing one of their monsters, bypassing destruction and targeting immunity, and once they control a Kaiju you can Special Summon a second Kaiju to your own side.

summary.title: Starters
points: Kyoutou Waterfront gains a Kaiju Counter each time a card goes to the GY and searches any Kaiju monster once per turn while it holds three or more counters.

Interrupted Kaiju Slumber destroys all monsters on the field to Special Summon two Kaijus with different names from the Deck (one to each side), then banishes itself from the GY next turn to search a Kaiju.
The Kaiju Files destroys a Kaiju on the field to Special Summon a different one from your Deck, or sends itself to the GY to search a Kaiju Spell or Trap.

summary.title: Opening: Kyoutou Waterfront + Any Kaiju
steps: Going second, activate Kyoutou Waterfront and Tribute the opponent's strongest boss monster to give them a low-ATK Kaiju such as Gameciel, the Sea Turtle Kaiju, or activate Interrupted Kaiju Slumber to clear the board and place a Kaiju on each field.

As cards hit the GY, Kyoutou Waterfront accumulates Kaiju Counters; activate its effect at three counters to search a high-ATK Kaiju like Jizukiru, Dogoran, or Thunder King, then Special Summon it to your own field.

summary.title: Kaiju Counters & Mecha-Kaijus
summary.text: Each player can control only one Kaiju monster, and every Kaiju's activated effect removes Kaiju Counters from anywhere on the field (including Kyoutou Waterfront and Kaiju Capture Mission). That means giving the opponent a Kaiju does not let them use its effect if you keep the counters low, or if you spend the counters yourself with Gameciel or Jizukiru on your own side. Super Anti-Kaiju War Machine Mecha-Thunder-King discards itself as a Quick Effect to banish a Kaiju you control that the opponent owns and revive a monster from your GY.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Gameciel, the Sea Turtle Kaiju removes two Kaiju Counters as a Quick Effect to negate any card or effect activation and banish that card.
Jizukiru, the Star Destroying Kaiju removes three counters to negate a single-target effect and destroy a card on the field.

Dogoran, the Mad Flame Kaiju removes three counters to destroy all monsters the opponent controls, while Thunder King removes three counters to lock the opponent's activations for the turn and attack monsters up to three times.
Kumongous, the Sticky String Kaiju stops newly summoned opposing monsters from attacking or using effects, Gadarla halves all other monsters' ATK/DEF, and Radian spawns a 2800 ATK Fiend Token.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Kyoutou Waterfront protects itself from destruction by removing a counter instead, keeping your counter bank intact.
Kaiju Capture Mission flips a Kaiju face-down to gain a Kaiju Counter (up to three) and draws two cards if destroyed by the opponent.
